what: Analysing a workbook of concentration-response data
title: Utilities for Ecotoxicological Data Handling and Analysis
text: toxtools can take Excel workbook toxicity test results, work sheets hold data can fitted, fit bayesnec model set , write single PDF report. intended usable without writing R code. Put workbook inputs folder, run opens page browser: choose workbook, tick sheets analyse, press Run, watch progress, download report finishes. Nothing typed, analysis runs machine started . fitting done separate R process, page stays responsive closing browser tab stop . workflow can run console opening analysis/run_workbook.R running whole file. Results written outputs/, one folder per workbook, holding report, fitted objects estimates CSV files. inputs/ outputs/ excluded version control, laboratory workbook placed inputs/ never committed. sheet searched row column names giving concentration column response column, title block, blank rows blank columns laboratory form counted skipped, columns holding values derived response ignored. Sheets block skipped, report says . inputs/README.md describes sheet needs contain. report gives, sheet: data read; equations fitted model weights; model-averaged N(S)EC, EC10 EC50 credible intervals, units recorded sheet; model-averaged curve individual equations behind ; diagnostics, R-hat, Bayesian R-squared, -dispersion test chain traces. Fitting takes roughly twenty forty minutes per sheet. fit saved completes reused later run, interrupted run resumed calling run_workbook() . sheet analysed stop run: reason reported remaining sheets still fitted. functions can also used one step time: bayesnec, brms readxl needed fit, ggplot2, quarto, knitr, rmarkdown ragg report, shiny, bslib, DT callr app. declared Suggests, installing toxtools install , checked fitting starts rather . PDF report also needs LaTeX installation; tinytex::install_tinytex() provides one, choose web page format instead.
